title: With accelerated public investment, the steel industry has made a positive contribution to double-digit growth.
dek: Accelerated public investment has helped the steel industry contribute positively to double-digit growth, according to Vietnam.vn.
summary: Vietnam.vn reports that, with accelerated public investment, the steel industry has made a positive contribution to double-digit growth. The publisher gave only a headline, and it does not give production or demand figures.
keyFacts: Accelerated public investment has supported the steel industry
The steel industry has contributed to double-digit growth, according to the headline
whyItMatters: Public infrastructure spending appears to be supporting domestic steel demand in Vietnam, a significant regional producer and trader.
implications: Sustained public investment could support regional demand for long and flat products. Exporters into Southeast Asia should monitor this.

related.dek: China Daily reports that upgrades in new energy vehicles are a boon for the steel industry.
